specs.title: Business hours and blackout dates
specs.why: The availability engine cannot compute slots without a source of truth for when the business is open.
specs.scope: Per-tenant weekly schedule (open/close per weekday, multiple windows) plus date-specific overrides for holidays and closures. Expose an availability helper `getOpenWindows(date)`.
tasks: UI to edit the weekly schedule and add blackouts
Unit tests covering multi-window days and blackouts
acceptance: Owner can set different hours per weekday
The helper is exported for the availability engine to consume

specs.title: Manual booking entry
specs.why: Owners need to record walk-ins and phone bookings from day one, and it forces the double-booking constraint early.
specs.scope: Owner can add a booking from the dashboard: pick or create a client, select service, select slot, add notes. Enforce no-double-book with a database constraint.
tasks: Add a Postgres exclusion constraint on `(staffId, tstzrange)` for overlaps
Booking form with client search and inline create
Write an audit log entry on create
acceptance: An overlapping booking for the same staff is rejected at the database
The created booking appears in the calendar immediately
